text: Thank you for your support of this item at the November TEYCC. Unfortunately my office realized that not all development addresses had been included in the request for a report. At the advice of Permit Parking Staff I am asking for your support to reopen the item and include all addresses.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item TE20.57, to include all development addresses. 2. Amended the Recommendation so it now reads: 1. Toronto and East York Community Council direct Transportation to report back on excluding the development at 1327-1339 Queen Street East from the on-street permit parking program including requiring the applicant to state in all marketing materials, condominium disclosure documents, and sales agreements that the future owner, tenant, or sublet tenant or any other additional occupant or guest will be prohibited from applying for an on-street parking permit and the building will be excluded from any on-street permit specified area.
